events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: It's 35 years since the music world lost Freddie Mercury, the iconic frontman of Queen. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost him, Freddie Mercury's voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen track?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61

angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul' and changed everything. Which track from the album still gets you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
